tasks.label: Start Folio Fill - Gloster Document Studio
args: $node = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS*" -Filter node.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $node) { throw 'Node.js LTS was not found for this user.' }; $env:PATH = "$($node.DirectoryName);$env:PATH"; npm.cmd run dev
